system.description:
Your Nature Energy when fired from you become all the more potent, refined and efficient. Hijutsu you cast that makes ranged attacks can increase the number of attacks they make by +1. This bonus attack must be against a different creature in range.

Additionally, Hijutsu you cast that affects an area in the shape of a Line or Cone that forces a saving throw, cannot be made at advantage.
